thread.title_full: Man threatens to blow up MS utility company over power outage: authorities - NewsBreak

author: David Royer
title: Man threatens to blow up MS utility company over power outage: authorities - NewsBreak
text:
By David Royer Mike Suriani ,
7 hours ago
HOLLY SPRINGS, Miss. — Authorities say a man angry about his power being out threatened to blow up the Holly Springs Utility Department.
William Robert Pruitt allegedly called the utility company Sunday concerning the restoration of his power and, during that call, threatened to blow up the utility, the Marshall County Sheriff's Office said.
He was charged Monday with False Reporting of a Bomb and was arrested the next day.
Pruitt was granted a $2,500 bond Wednesday. He is currently out on bond awaiting court proceedings.
Power restoration efforts continue for Benton County, Marshall County, MS As of Tuesday, there were up to 600 Holly Springs Utility District customers without power as a result of Saturday’s storm.
The outages were scattered across Holly Springs, Marshall County and a portion of Benton County following a brief but powerful storm Saturday.
A Marshall County resident said the threat, though very wrong, must have come out of frustration.
"My thought is I really don't think he really meant that, but he was just responding out of anger due to the long power outages. We been out of power since Saturday," said the resident. "I really don't think he was going to blow up anything cause a person who gonna do something. They just gonna do it. They're not going to tell somebody what they're going to do."
